verdict.rationale: Ingesting at scale with async or batch processing and checking job status is a fair question for an agent knowledge and memory product, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows loading docs into a scope and connectors that keep Knowledge current. Nothing documents async or batch ingestion APIs, background job processing, or a way to check the status of background memory operations, so this is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can ingest at scale with async or batch processing and check the status of background memory operations
